preservation_rules: Require a complete organisation name or a documented short form that remains distinctive in the source sentence; reject prefixes ending in 'of', 'for', 'and', or another continuation marker.
Reject legal, financial, transport, education, health, and policy vocabulary when it is functioning as a category or description rather than a proper name.
A single capitalised occurrence is insufficient when other reviewed excerpts show the same phrase in ordinary lower-case prose; use the longer proper name or an official acronym instead.
When a short phrase sometimes refers to a real body but also occurs generically, reject the broad key and preserve only a fully qualified form.
Keep person-name mentions out of organisation aliases unless the entity type is independently verified as an organisation.
